common:generalComment.#text: Steel wire is an extremely useful and versatile material that can be found in many things you use everyday in the home, as well as in the car you drive. It is also useful in commercial, industrial and military applications—for cleaning, for spring-loaded devices, for reinforcing, for structural integrity, and even for making music. Steel wire is a metallic, cylindrical, and flexible strand that is commonly used to conduct electricity. It can form a wire rope which has even more uses in both private and public sector industries.

common:generalComment.#text: Industrial dust is a common occurrence in factories and warehouses due to the movement of products, vehicles, personnel, boxes and due to the myriad of processes. This dust rapidly becomes airborne and can cause all manner of problems for businesses. Industrial dust collectors are essential in plants, factories, and other processing facilities because they capture and contain harmful particles from the air. These collectors are typically large pieces of equipment that can be installed either inside or outside the facility.

common:generalComment.#text: Elementary flow for particulate matter emitted to air, unspecified subcompartment, where the particle-size fraction is not specified. The reference property is mass, expressed in kilograms. No particular particle-size distribution, chemical composition, stack height or LCIA characterization factor is assigned by this Flow definition. Source context retained from the preceding version: Song et al. (2021), DOI 10.13671/j.hjkxxb.2021.0276, reports 0.01689 kg/t of particulate-matter emissions from clinker preheating and calcination after dust collection, without reporting particle size. This is a source-specific application example, not the amount per kilogram of this Flow or a requirement that all uses represent the same treatment technology. Actual emissions, controls and source evidence belong to the corresponding Process exchange; characterization coverage is assessed for the exact Flow and the selected LCIA method.

common:generalComment.#text: Refractory bricks are materials capable of maintaining structural and performance stability under high-temperature conditions. They are commonly used as linings in high-temperature industrial equipment such as kilns, furnaces, and boilers. Made primarily from high-alumina, silica, or magnesia-based materials, refractory bricks are manufactured through high-temperature firing. They are characterized by high heat resistance, thermal shock resistance, and strong chemical stability, making them widely used in industries such as metallurgy, construction materials, and chemicals.
耐火砖是一种能够在高温环境下保持结构和性能稳定的材料，通常用于高温工业设备如窑炉、熔炉和锅炉内衬。其主要原材料包括高铝矿物、硅质材料和镁质材料，通过高温烧制而成。耐火砖具有高耐热性、抗热震性以及较强的化学稳定性，在冶金、建材、化工等行业中广泛应用。

common:generalComment.#text: Hydraulic fluid's main function in hydraulic systems is to transmit power from one part of a system to another. It converts mechanical energy into hydraulic pressure, which is uniformly distributed throughout the fluid. The pressure can move pistons or cylinders, which in turn move other parts of the system. Hydraulic fluid is a non-compressible, engineered medium that provides lubrication and heat and power transfer properties. It is composed of a base oil, which can be mineral or synthetic, along with various performance-enhancing additives.
液压流体在液压系统中的主要功能是将动力从系统的一个部分传递到另一个部分。它将机械能转化为液压，液压均匀分布在整个流体中。压力可以移动活塞或气缸，进而移动系统的其他部分。液压流体是一种不可压缩的工程介质，具有润滑、传热和动力传递特性。它由矿物油或合成基础油以及各种性能增强添加剂组成。
